summary.text: Possession true inheritance is Giant Sun Immortal Venerable's true inheritance of the immortal art Possession. Its core is rank six possession Immortal Gu.

claims.text: Fang Yuan’s special will reads this as the third inheritance in the true inheritance secluded domain of Eighty-Eight True Yang Building: a lifespan increasing method for Gu Immortals, created after Giant Sun Immortal Venerable had an inspiration. He named the immortal art Possession. Besides the core Immortal Gu, the set included about three thousand rank five mortal Gu of all kinds. The true inheritance is only an empty shell; those Gu have already been taken. In Fang Yuan’s previous life, during the chaotic battle of the five regions, possession Immortal Gu was extremely well-known, and many high ranking Gu Immortals used it to extend lifespan. Although it is rank six, Fang Yuan treats it as a Gu that could change the structure of the world.

Words left inside criticize using the soul to take over a body as a struggle at death’s door, name lifespan Gu as the best option, and close that the maintenance of longevity means the defiance of heaven: hard, hard, hard. The writer is Spectral Soul Demon Venerable. Fang Yuan judges the chance that Spectral Soul took possession Immortal Gu is very slim, because those words show no interest in the possession method. Giant Sun set eighty-eight true inheritances in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. Mo Yao once said that in her time only fifty-three remained, and Fang Yuan notes that fewer remain now.
This third true inheritance is an ordinary true inheritance.
After the empty shell, he finds two more ordinary wisdom-path inheritances, then asks why he has not found an unparalleled inheritance yet.

Dong Fang Chang Fan’s star will tells Old Lord Can Yang that he obtained this possession technique in Eighty-Eight True Yang Building. The contents allow one to possess mortals and even Gu Immortals. To possess Gu Immortals, the user’s cultivation must be higher than the target’s, and after possession the immortal aperture would be the target’s immortal aperture, which Dong Fang Chang Fan calls unfitting and full of disadvantages. He later built a formation on that technique as a foundation, so he could possess a mortal while mobilizing origin cores of Gu Immortals of the same bloodline to form a new wisdom path immortal aperture. He used the possession technique to transact with Immortal Crane Sect, releasing its contents in exchange for resources. This possession technique came from Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.
When seeking cooperation with Immortal Crane Sect, Dong Fang Chang Fan says he has a lifespan extension method for Gu Immortals, named possession, created by Giant Sun Immortal Venerable.

Fang Yuan’s fourth soul search of Dong Fang Chang Fan yields the possession technique: not only the original version Dong Fang Chang Fan obtained in the true inheritance secluded domain when he was young, but also the method he modified, and the method of extracting origin cores of Gu Immortals of the same bloodline to advance to Gu Immortal at once. Fang Yuan notes that this possession method will anger heaven and earth, and that the resulting heavenly tribulation and earthly calamity will be terrifying.

Spectral Soul Demon Venerable holds Giant Sun’s true inheritance inside Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and says that this possession method can extend lifespan, while possessing a body using the soul is only a desperate method and death is still unavoidable. He adds that Giant Sun created Eighty-Eight True Yang Building and attempted to plunder the lifespan Gu in Northern Plains, that heaven’s will is vicious and fewer and fewer lifespan Gu are being produced, and that heaven’s will dictates the production of lifespan Gu, so the crucial thing for a long life is heaven’s will.

Location.text: True inheritance secluded domain, Eighty-Eight True Yang Building
